name: Travelling Salesman Problem Quantum Benchmark
description: Benchmark of quantum approaches to the Travelling Salesman Problem, a canonical NP-hard combinatorial optimization task. Instances are encoded as QUBO/Ising Hamiltonians and solved using QAOA or VQE on gate-based hardware, or via quantum annealing. Current NISQ-era implementations handle instances of up to roughly six cities, making TSP a demanding test of quantum optimizer quality.
significance: Exposes the harsh scaling reality of quantum optimization: the most famous NP-hard problem remains limited to toy sizes on current quantum hardware.
